newsitem.title: USA: Meridian 10-K to show reduced equity.
newsitem.headline: Meridian 10-K to show reduced equity.

text.p: Meridian National Corp said Friday it would soon file a 10-K annual report for its fiscal year ended February 28, 1997, that will show reduced shareholder equity.
The 10-K will reflect restated financial statements for the fiscal years ended February 29, 1996, and February 28, 1995, to reduce the amortization period of a capital lease, it said.
The change has resulted in a reduction of shareholder equity of $358,000, with a balance of $1.2 million at February 28, 1997, the company said.

Meridian said it had received notice from the Nasdaq Stock Market that its publicly traded securities would be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market effective June 25 if the company had not filed a 10-K by then.
The company said it expects to file its 10-K by June 24.
